description: This file defines an enumeration PeriodFrequencyType representing different period frequencies (days, weeks, months, years, whole term, invalid). It includes methods for mapping integer values to enum constants, checking the type of period, and retrieving code and value attributes.

classes.name: PeriodFrequencyType
classes.description: An enum representing various period frequency types used in the application, with utility methods for conversion and checks.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding PeriodFrequencyType enum; defaults to INVALID.

methods.name: isMonthly
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is MONTHS.

methods.name: isYearly
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is YEARS.

methods.name: isWeekly
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is WEEKS.

methods.name: isDaily
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is DAYS.

methods.name: isWholeTerm
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is WHOLE_TERM.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is INVALID.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all valid period frequency types, excluding INVALID.
